core_purpose: Discover and explore the vast world of isomeric words by rearranging the letters of their favorite English words, and unlock a new level of wordplay and vocabulary mastery

target_personas.name: Word Enthusiast
target_personas.context: When using the app to play and learn about word anagrams and isomeric words
target_personas.motivation: To explore and understand the relationships between words and their anagrams
target_personas.pain_point: Frustration when trying to find all possible anagrams for a word

target_personas.name: Casual Gamer
target_personas.context: When using the app to play and compete with friends
target_personas.motivation: To have fun and challenge themselves with word anagrams and isomeric words
target_personas.pain_point: Disappointment when unable to find all possible anagrams for a word

target_personas.name: Language Learner
target_personas.context: When using the app to learn and practice vocabulary
target_personas.motivation: To improve their language skills and knowledge of word relationships
target_personas.pain_point: Difficulty when trying to find and remember new words and their anagrams

behavioral_dynamics: Users enjoy exploring and discovering new words and their relationships
Users are motivated by competition and challenge
Users learn best through interactive and engaging experiences
Users become frustrated when unable to find all possible anagrams
core_use_cases: Enter a word and receive a list of possible anagrams
Attempt to find and list all possible isomeric words for a given word
Complete all possible anagrams for a word to progress to the next word
logical_workflows: Enter word -> Display count of possible anagrams -> User goes to a page where they can type the possible anagram that they can think of
> User receives feedback on correct and incorrect words
Complete all possible anagrams -> User progresses to the next word
User becomes frustrated or disengaged -> App offers to shelve the session to go and type a new word similar to the start page.
human_edge_cases: User enters a word with repeated letters or special characters
User is unable to find all possible anagrams for a word due to limited knowledge or skills
User becomes frustrated or disengaged when unable to find all possible anagrams
User experiences technical issues or app crashes
User forgets their progress or needs to resume later
success_indicators: User completes all possible anagrams for a word
User finds and lists all possible isomeric words for a given word
User progresses to the next word with a sense of accomplishment and engagement
User feels motivated and encouraged to continue playing and learning
